# Bug Bounty Program Finder — Project Scaffold I'll create a complete project structure for you. Based on your requirements, I'm building a **web application** that aggregates, filters, and searches bug bounty programs based on user-defined criteria. Before I commit to a final build, I have **follow-up questions** at the bottom — but here's a fully functional starter project you can run right now. --- ## 📁 File Structure ``` bug-bounty-finder/ ├── backend/ │ ├── app.py │ ├── scraper.py │ ├── database.py │ ├── models.py │ ├── config.py │ ├── requirements.txt │ └── data/ │ └── programs_seed.json ├── frontend/ │ ├── index.html │ ├── style.css │ └── script.js ├── tests/ │ └── test_api.py ├── .env.example ├── .gitignore └── README.md ``` --- ## 🔧 Dependencies & Libraries **Backend (Python 3.10+):** - `Flask` — web framework - `Flask-CORS` — cross-origin support - `SQLAlchemy` — ORM - `requests` — HTTP fetching - `beautifulsoup4` — HTML parsing for scraping - `python-dotenv` — env management - `pytest` — testing **Frontend:** Vanilla HTML/CSS/JS (no build step needed). Easy to swap for React later. --- ## 📄 Files ### `backend/requirements.txt` ``` Flask==3.0.0 Flask-CORS==4.0.0 SQLAlchemy==2.0.23 requests==2.31.0 beautifulsoup4==4.12.2 python-dotenv==1.0.0 pytest==7.4.3 ``` ### `backend/config.py` ```python import os from dotenv import load_dotenv load_dotenv() class Config: # SQLite is fine for dev; swap to Postgres in production DATABASE_URL = os.getenv("DATABASE_URL", "sqlite:///bounties.db") DEBUG = os.getenv("DEBUG", "True") == "True" # Optional API keys for integrations (HackerOne, Bugcrowd) HACKERONE_API_KEY = os.getenv("HACKERONE_API_KEY", "") BUGCROWD_API_KEY = os.getenv("BUGCROWD_API_KEY", "") ``` ### `backend/models.py` ```python from sqlalchemy import Column, Integer, String, Float, Text, DateTime from sqlalchemy.orm import declarative_base from datetime import datetime Base = declarative_base() class Program(Base): """ Represents a bug bounty program. Stored fields chosen to support filtering by: - bounty size (min/max payout) - vulnerability types accepted - platform reputation - participation ease (open vs invite-only) """ __tablename__ = "programs" id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True) name = Column(String(255), nullable=False, unique=True) platform = Column(String(100)) # e.g. HackerOne, Bugcrowd, Intigriti, self-hosted url = Column(String(500)) min_bounty = Column(Float, default=0.0) max_bounty = Column(Float, default=0.0) vuln_types = Column(Text) # comma-separated: XSS,SQLi,RCE... scope = Column(Text) # what's in scope invite_only = Column(Integer, default=0) # 0 = public, 1 = private/invite reputation_score = Column(Float, default=0.0) # 0-10, our calculated metric last_updated = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow) def to_dict(self): return { "id": self.id, "name": self.name, "platform": self.platform, "url": self.url, "min_bounty": self.min_bounty, "max_bounty": self.max_bounty, "vuln_types": self.vuln_types.split(",") if self.vuln_types else [], "scope": self.scope, "invite_only": bool(self.invite_only), "reputation_score": self.reputation_score, "last_updated": self.last_updated.isoformat() if self.last_updated else None, } ``` ### `backend/database.py` ```python from sqlalchemy import create_engine from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker from models import Base, Program from config import Config import json, os engine = create_engine(Config.DATABASE_URL, echo=False) SessionLocal = sessionmaker(bind=engine) def init_db(): """Create tables and seed initial data if DB is empty.""" Base.metadata.create_all(engine) session = SessionLocal() try: if session.query(Program).count() == 0: seed_path = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "data", "programs_seed.json") if os.path.exists(seed_path): with open(seed_path) as f: data = json.load(f) for p in data: session.add(Program(**p)) session.commit() print(f"Seeded {len(data)} programs.") finally: session.close() def get_session(): return SessionLocal() ``` ### `backend/data/programs_seed.json` ```json [ { "name": "GitHub Security Bug Bounty", "platform": "HackerOne", "url": "https://bounty.github.com/", "min_bounty": 617, "max_bounty": 30000, "vuln_types": "XSS,SQLi,RCE,SSRF,IDOR,Auth Bypass", "scope": "github.com, api.github.com, GitHub Desktop", "invite_only": 0, "reputation_score": 9.5 }, { "name": "Google Vulnerability Reward Program", "platform": "Self-hosted", "url": "https://bughunters.google.com/", "min_bounty": 100, "max_bounty": 31337, "vuln_types": "XSS,RCE,Auth Bypass,Info Disclosure", "scope": "*.google.com, *.youtube.com, Android", "invite_only": 0, "reputation_score": 10.0 }, { "name": "Shopify", "platform": "HackerOne", "url": "https://hackerone.com/shopify", "min_bounty": 500, "max_bounty": 50000, "vuln_types": "RCE,SQLi,SSRF,Privilege Escalation", "scope": "*.shopify.com, Shopify mobile apps", "invite_only": 0, "reputation_score": 9.0 }, { "name": "Mozilla", "platform": "Bugcrowd", "url": "https://www.mozilla.org/en-US/security/bug-bounty/", "min_bounty": 500, "max_bounty": 10000, "vuln_types": "XSS,CSRF,RCE", "scope": "Firefox, Firefox for Android, Thunderbird", "invite_only": 0, "reputation_score": 8.5 }, { "name": "Tesla", "platform": "Bugcrowd", "url": "https://bugcrowd.com/tesla", "min_bounty": 100, "max_bounty": 15000, "vuln_types": "Vehicle Systems,Web,Mobile", "scope": "tesla.com, vehicle firmware", "invite_only": 0, "reputation_score": 9.2 } ] ``` ### `backend/scraper.py` ```python """ Scraper module — fetches programs from public directories. NOTE: Always respect robots.txt and platform ToS. HackerOne and Bugcrowd both offer official APIs — prefer those when possible. """ import requests from bs4 import BeautifulSoup from database import get_session from models import Program from datetime import datetime HEADERS = {"User-Agent": "BugBountyFinder/1.0 (educational)"} def scrape_disclose_io(): """ disclose.io maintains an open-source list of programs. This is a placeholder — real implementation would parse their JSON feed: https://github.com/disclose/diodb """ url = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/disclose/diodb/master/program-list.json" try: r = requests.get(url, headers=HEADERS, timeout=10) if r.status_code != 200: return [] return r.json() except Exception as e: print(f"[scraper] disclose.io failed: {e}") return [] def update_database(): """Refresh DB with newly scraped data. Idempotent (upsert by name).""" session = get_session() programs = scrape_disclose_io() added = 0 for entry in programs[:50]: # limit for demo name = entry.get("program_name") or entry.get("name") if not name: continue existing = session.query(Program).filter_by(name=name).first() if existing: existing.last_updated = datetime.utcnow() else: session.add(Program( name=name, platform=entry.get("launch_date", "Unknown"), url=entry.get("policy_url", ""), vuln_types="", scope=entry.get("contact_url", ""), invite_only=0, reputation_score=5.0, )) added += 1 session.commit() session.close() return added if __name__ == "__main__": print(f"Added {update_database()} new programs.") ``` ### `backend/app.py` ```python from flask import Flask, request, jsonify, send_from_directory from flask_cors import CORS from database import init_db, get_session from models import Program from scraper import update_database import os app = Flask(__name__, static_folder="../frontend", static_url_path="") CORS(app) # Initialize DB on startup init_db() @app.route("/") def index(): return send_from_directory("../frontend", "index.html") @app.route("/api/programs", methods=["GET"]) def list_programs(): """ Query params (all optional): - min_bounty: float - max_bounty: float - platform: str - vuln: str (matches inside vuln_types) - public_only: 'true' to exclude invite-only - min_reputation: float - q: free-text search (name/scope) - sort: 'reputation' | 'max_bounty' | 'name' """ session = get_session() q = session.query(Program) min_bounty = request.args.get("min_bounty", type=float) max_bounty = request.args.get("max_bounty", type=float) platform = request.args.get("platform") vuln = request.args.get("vuln") public_only = request.args.get("public_only") == "true" min_rep = request.args.get("min_reputation", type=float) search = request.args.get("q") sort = request.args.get("sort", "reputation") if min_bounty is not None: q = q.filter(Program.max_bounty >= min_bounty) if max_bounty is not None: q = q.filter(Program.min_bounty <= max_bounty) if platform: q = q.filter(Program.platform.ilike(f"%{platform}%")) if vuln: q = q.filter(Program.vuln_types.ilike(f"%{vuln}%")) if public_only: q = q.filter(Program.invite_only == 0) if min_rep is not None: q = q.filter(Program.reputation_score >= min_rep) if search: like = f"%{search}%" q = q.filter((Program.name.ilike(like)) | (Program.scope.ilike(like))) if sort == "max_bounty": q = q.order_by(Program.max_bounty.desc()) elif sort == "name": q = q.order_by(Program.name.asc()) else: q = q.order_by(Program.reputation_score.desc()) results = [p.to_dict() for p in q.all()] session.close() return jsonify({"count": len(results), "results": results}) @app.route("/api/programs/", methods=["GET"]) def get_program(pid): session = get_session() p = session.query(Program).get(pid) session.close() if not p: return jsonify({"error": "not found"}), 404 return jsonify(p.to_dict()) @app.route("/api/refresh", methods=["POST"]) def refresh(): """Trigger a scrape/update. In production, protect this endpoint!""" added = update_database() return jsonify({"added": added}) @app.route("/api/stats", methods=["GET"]) def stats(): session = get_session() total = session.query(Program).count() avg_max = session.query(Program).all() avg = sum(p.max_bounty for p in avg_max) / total if total else 0 session.close() return jsonify({"total_programs": total, "avg_max_bounty": round(avg, 2)}) if __name__ == "__main__": app.run(host="0.0.0.0", port=5000, debug=True) ``` ### `frontend/index.html` ```html Bug Bounty Finder

🛡️ Bug Bounty Finder

Search & filter active bug bounty programs.
